chart.description: Pod GPU graphics engine active percentage from DCGM profiling metrics.
chart.name: Pod GPU graphics engine usage (instant/average)
chart.programText:
A = data('DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE', filter=filter('k8s.cluster.name', '*') and filter('k8s.node.name', '*') and filter('k8s.namespace.name', '*') and filter('pod', '*') and filter('container', '*'), rollup='average').scale(100).mean(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.node.name', 'k8s.namespace.name', 'pod', 'container']).publish(label='A')
B = (A).mean(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='B')
